items.description:
Absolute Dental is a general dental practice offering routine check-ups, fillings, extractions and preventative oral care for patients of all ages, alongside more involved restorative and cosmetic treatments such as crowns, bridges and tooth whitening when a patient's needs call for them. As with most community dental practices, appointments are typically required, with the focus on building an ongoing relationship with patients rather than handling only emergency visits.

Trading from Shop 4 in Glencairn Shopping Centre on Birkenhead Road, the practice serves Glencairn and the wider Simon's Town area along the False Bay coastline, giving residents a dentist close to home rather than a trip into central Cape Town. It suits families and individuals looking for a reliable, local option for everyday dental care as well as more occasional procedures.

Ackermans is a long-standing South African retail chain built around affordable, everyday fashion, stocking clothing, footwear, accessories and homeware for babies, children and adults. The brand is known for frequent in-store promotions and a layby facility that lets budget-conscious shoppers plan larger purchases, a model that has kept it a fixture of value retail in suburbs and townships across the country.

This branch trades from Mitchells Plain Town Centre on Symphony Walk, in the heart of one of Cape Town's largest residential and shopping nodes, within reach of neighbouring banks and grocery stores in the same precinct. It is a practical stop for parents restocking school uniforms, workwear or household basics without travelling further afield, and is open Monday to Saturday with shorter Sunday hours.

Barksole is a specialist repair and key-cutting service covering shoe and leather repairs, luggage repair, key cutting, engraving and a dry-cleaning drop-off point, the kind of multi-skill trade that has largely disappeared from larger retail chains. Customers typically bring in worn footwear, a broken zip, a lost key or an item needing a nameplate or an engraved gift, work that depends on a trained hand rather than mass production.

This branch trades from Shop G34 in Howard Centre on Howard Drive, Pinelands, serving shoppers already in the centre for groceries or other errands. It suits anyone needing a quick turnaround on a repair or a spare key cut while running other errands nearby, trading through the week and on Saturday mornings.

Beantree Cafe is a casual, family-oriented eatery operating inside the Spar supermarket in Strandfontein, serving a menu built around hand-crafted burgers, slow-cooked ribs and other comfort food alongside coffee brewed from Lavazza beans. The in-store setting makes it a natural stop for shoppers wanting a sit-down meal or a takeaway order without a separate outing, a format that has become common for cafes attached to supermarkets along the Cape Flats coastline.

Located inside Spar Strandfontein at the corner of Wavecrest Avenue and Benguela Avenue, the cafe draws its trade from the surrounding Strandfontein community and passing grocery shoppers. It works well for a quick breakfast, a weekday lunch or a relaxed weekend meal before or after a shop.

Bel-Kem Pharmacy is an independent, community-based pharmacy offering prescription dispensing and chronic medication management, alongside over-the-counter remedies and everyday health, wellness and personal-care products. Independent pharmacies of this kind typically provide a more personal service than large retail chains, with pharmacists able to advise on medication and refer patients to nearby clinics or doctors when needed.

Situated at the corner of Barberton Link and Amandel Road in Belhar, the pharmacy serves residents of Belhar and surrounding suburbs who need a nearby dispensary for both scripted medicine and day-to-day health items. It trades long hours into the evening, every day of the week, making it a convenient option outside standard working hours.

Bonteheuwel Pharmacy is a community pharmacy providing prescription dispensing, repeat chronic medication and a range of over-the-counter medicines, vitamins and personal-care products for everyday health needs. As with most neighbourhood pharmacies, the emphasis is on accessible, walk-in service for residents who need medicine dispensed or advice on a minor ailment without booking ahead.

The pharmacy is based at 488 Bonteheuwel Avenue in Bonteheuwel, in the heart of the suburb it is named for, giving local households a dispensary within walking distance of home. It is geared toward routine, everyday pharmacy needs rather than a destination stop, serving the surrounding streets, schools and clinics nearby.

Capitec Bank is one of South Africa's largest retail banks, built around straightforward, low-fee banking aimed at everyday consumers rather than corporate clients. Branches typically handle account openings, card and PIN services, cash deposits and withdrawals, loan applications and general account queries, with the Capitec app supporting most other day-to-day transactions.

This branch trades from Shop 8A in Goodwood Mall, at the corner of Voortrekker Road and MacDonald Street in Goodwood Estate, among the mall's other retail and financial tenants. It serves Goodwood residents and surrounding Voortrekker Road shoppers who need in-person banking alongside a regular shopping trip, with extended weekend hours supporting those who cannot visit during the working week.

Chapman's Hardware is a general hardware store stocking tools, building materials, paint, plumbing and electrical supplies, garden products and the everyday items a household or small building project typically needs. Independent hardware stores of this kind usually combine retail stock with practical advice from staff familiar with local trade suppliers, filling the gap between a large chain store and a specialist builders' merchant.

Based at 1 Irene Way in Sunnydale, in the valley area south of Cape Town, the store serves residents and tradespeople working across Sunnydale, Noordhoek and the surrounding Deep South suburbs. It opens on Sundays as well as through the week, a convenience for weekend DIY projects and last-minute repairs.

Clicks is a national health, beauty and pharmacy retailer, combining a dispensing pharmacy with a retail range of skincare, cosmetics, baby products, vitamins and household basics. Clicks stores typically include a pharmacist's counter for prescriptions and chronic medication alongside the ClubCard loyalty programme that rewards regular shoppers with points and health-related discounts.

This branch trades from Shop 12 and 13 in Constantia Emporium on Ladies Mile Road, among the centre's other specialty retailers in the suburb of Constantia. It gives local residents a combined pharmacy and beauty stop within their own neighbourhood centre, open into the evening on most days of the week.

Clicks Sanlam (Parow) is a branch of the national Clicks pharmacy and health, beauty and homeware chain, offering a dispensary alongside an in-store clinic for basic health screenings, vaccinations and minor ailment consultations. The retail side carries skincare, cosmetics, vitamins and everyday household goods, with the ClubCard loyalty scheme used across the Clicks network for points and promotions.

The store trades from Shop 168 in Parow Centre on Voortrekker Road, Parow East, one of the busiest retail strips on the Cape Flats, serving shoppers already in the centre for groceries and other errands. Weekday, Saturday and Sunday trading hours make it accessible for both routine pharmacy visits and quick clinic appointments.

Clicks Pharmacy Seaside Village is a branch of the Clicks health, beauty and pharmacy chain, stocking a dispensary for prescription and chronic medicine alongside skincare, cosmetics, vitamins and homeware for everyday shopping. Like other Clicks stores, it runs the ClubCard loyalty programme and typically offers basic health services such as blood pressure checks alongside its retail counter.

The store trades from Seaside Village Shopping Centre at the corner of Otto du Plessis Drive and Cormorant Avenue in Bloubergstrand, a coastal suburb on Cape Town's west coast known for its beachfront and views across the bay to Table Mountain. It is a convenient pharmacy and retail stop for residents and visitors to the area, open seven days a week.

Debonairs Pizza is a national pizza chain known for flame-grilled pizzas alongside sides such as chicken wings, garlic bread and desserts, sold for takeaway, delivery or eat-in depending on the branch. Its menu is built around a handful of signature pizza ranges and regular combo deals aimed at families and groups ordering for a meal at home.

This outlet trades from Shop 29 in Capricorn Square on Capricorn Boulevard North, Muizenberg, among the centre's other food and retail tenants. Open daily from mid-morning into the evening, it serves the surrounding Muizenberg and Marina da Gama area for a quick takeaway meal or a delivery order to the beachfront suburb.

Decofurn Furniture is a South African discount furniture retailer known for selling lounge suites, bedroom sets, dining furniture and homeware directly from large warehouse-style showrooms, cutting out some of the markup found at smaller boutique stores. The chain's model relies on high stock volumes and factory-direct pricing rather than made-to-order pieces, appealing to buyers furnishing a whole home on a budget.

This branch operates from Montague Business Park on Emerald Road in Montague Gardens, an industrial and retail node on Cape Town's northern side known for several large-format furniture and homeware outlets. It draws shoppers from across the greater Cape Town area wanting to compare furniture ranges and take stock away immediately rather than waiting on a custom order.

Dis-Chem is one of South Africa's largest pharmacy and healthcare retail chains, combining a full dispensing pharmacy with a wide retail range of vitamins, baby products, skincare, cosmetics and household goods. Many branches also host in-store clinics offering vaccinations, basic health screenings and wellness consultations alongside the pharmacy counter.

This branch trades from the Panorama Healthcare Centre at the corner of Hennie Winterbach Street and Rothschild Boulevard in Panorama, a precinct built around medical and allied health practices. Its location puts it within easy reach of the surrounding doctors' rooms and specialists, making it a practical stop for patients collecting a prescription right after a consultation.

The practice is an orthodontic one, focused on the diagnosis and treatment of misaligned teeth and jaws, offering options such as braces and retainers for both younger patients and adults seeking straighter teeth later in life. Orthodontic treatment of this kind typically spans months or years of adjustment visits, so the practice is built around an ongoing relationship with patients rather than single consultations.

It operates from Shop 5 in the Ipic Shopping Centre on Door De Kraal Avenue in Kenridge, part of the greater Durbanville area north of Cape Town. The practice serves patients from Kenridge, Durbanville and surrounding suburbs who need specialist orthodontic care closer to home than the city centre.

Edgars is one of South Africa's longest-running department store chains, selling clothing, footwear, accessories, cosmetics and homeware across menswear, womenswear and kids' ranges, alongside store credit accounts that have long been part of its retail model. As a department store rather than a single-category shop, it is built for broader family shopping trips rather than a quick, single-item purchase.

This branch is one of four anchor tenants at Longbeach Mall, at the corner of Buller Louw Drive and Sunnydale Road in Noordhoek, anchoring the mall alongside its other large retailers. It serves shoppers across the Noordhoek valley and greater Deep South area who would otherwise need to travel further into Cape Town for a full department store range.

Edgemead Motors is a fuel station and vehicle service garage trading under the Engen brand, offering fuel, basic vehicle maintenance and repairs alongside an on-site convenience store for everyday shopping while filling up. Garages of this kind typically combine forecourt fuel sales with a small workshop handling services such as oil changes, tyres and general mechanical work.

Located at 7 Edgemead Drive in Edgemead, the station serves motorists travelling through this northern Cape Town suburb as well as residents needing a nearby garage for routine vehicle maintenance. Its convenience store extends its use beyond fuel and repairs to a quick stop for snacks, drinks and basic groceries.

Game is a long-established South African general merchandise retailer selling electronics, appliances, homeware, toys, sporting goods and everyday household items under one roof, positioned as a lower-cost alternative to specialist electronics or homeware stores. Its stores are typically large-format, with seasonal promotions around back-to-school, Black Friday and the festive season driving much of its trade.

This branch trades from Shop L80 in Cape Gate Shopping Centre, at the corner of Okavango and De Bron Road in Brackenfell, one of the larger regional malls serving Cape Town's northern suburbs. It gives shoppers in Brackenfell and the surrounding Boston and Kraaifontein areas a single stop for electronics, homeware and general goods without travelling further into the city.

Goldwagen is a South African franchise network supplying automotive spares, oils, lubricants, batteries and accessories for passenger cars, bakkies and trucks, aimed at both private motorists and workshops needing parts for a repair or service. The franchise model means individual branches typically carry a broad spares range alongside the buying power and parts network of a national supplier.

This branch trades from 46 Voortrekker Road in Goodwood, a stretch of road known for its concentration of motor spares and vehicle-related businesses. It serves motorists and mechanics across Goodwood and the surrounding Voortrekker Road corridor who need parts without waiting on a special order.

GSK (GlaxoSmithKline) is a multinational pharmaceutical and healthcare company, and its Epping Industria site forms part of the group's South African manufacturing and distribution operations, supporting the supply of medicines and healthcare products to the local and regional market. Facilities of this kind typically combine production, warehousing and logistics rather than operating as a public-facing retail outlet.

The site is based at 39 Hawkins Avenue in Epping Industria 1, within one of Cape Town's main industrial zones, alongside numerous other manufacturing and logistics operations. It functions as part of GSK's broader supply chain rather than a storefront, supporting the distribution of pharmaceutical products across South Africa from this Cape Town base.

Hair Connection is a hairdressing salon offering cuts, styling, colouring, relaxing and other hair treatments for men, women and children, the kind of full-service salon found in most suburban shopping centres. Salons in this category typically work on a walk-in and appointment basis, with staff trained across a range of hair types and styles to suit a broad client base.

The salon trades from Shop 132 in the Quicktrip Centre in Portlands, Mitchells Plain, among the centre's other retail and service tenants. It serves the local Portlands and wider Mitchells Plain community as a nearby option for regular haircuts and styling without needing to travel to a salon further afield.

Just Fencing is a fencing contractor installing boundary and security fencing for homes, farms and commercial properties, with work typically covering palisade, vibracrete, mesh and electric fencing depending on a site's security needs and budget. Contractors in this trade generally handle both new installations and repairs to existing fencing, often working alongside electric fence and gate automation specialists.

Based at 15 Blackbird Road in Sunnydale, in the valley area south of Cape Town, the business serves residential and smallholding properties across the Deep South, an area with a mix of suburban homes and larger rural plots that often need perimeter security. It operates on weekdays, fitting around site visits and installation schedules.

Killarney Gardens Hardware is a hardware merchant stocking building materials, tools, fixings, paint and general trade supplies for both tradespeople and homeowners working on repairs or small projects. Stores of this kind usually serve a mix of contractors buying in bulk for a job and individuals picking up supplies for a single home repair.

Trading from 2 Killarney Avenue in Killarney Gardens, part of the Milnerton industrial area north of Cape Town, the store serves the many building, manufacturing and logistics businesses based in the surrounding light-industrial precinct. Early weekday opening from 07:00 suits contractors needing supplies before starting a day's work on site.

Kwikspar is part of the Spar group's smaller-format supermarket range, stocking groceries, fresh produce, bakery items, frozen goods and everyday household essentials in a more compact store than a full Spar or Superspar. The format is built for convenience shopping, letting customers pick up daily essentials quickly without navigating a larger supermarket layout, and often includes a butchery or deli counter alongside the main grocery aisles.

This branch trades from Prospur Shopping Centre at 74 Churchill Road in Plumstead, serving the surrounding southern suburbs neighbourhood with a nearby grocery option alongside the centre's other retail tenants. Long daily trading hours, stretching into the evening and covering Sundays, make it a practical stop for top-up shopping outside a weekly big grocery run, suiting residents who prefer a quick, local shop over a trip to a larger supermarket further away.

Mini-Kem Pharmacy is an independent pharmacy offering prescription dispensing and chronic medication management, alongside a range of over-the-counter medicines and everyday health and wellness products. This kind of smaller, single-centre pharmacy often allows for more direct, personal service from staff than a larger retail pharmacy counter, serving a steady base of regular customers.

The pharmacy trades near Entrance 1 of Goodwood Mall at 22 McDonald Street in Goodwood Estate, serving shoppers already visiting the mall for groceries and other retail needs. Weekday and Saturday morning trading hours cover the bulk of the working week for residents needing a nearby dispensary.

Moksh Indian Restaurant serves North Indian cuisine, with a menu built around tandoori and clay-oven dishes, traditional curries and breads drawing on classic Indian cooking styles. Restaurants of this kind typically combine a sit-down dining room with takeaway orders, catering to diners looking for a specific regional cuisine rather than a general international menu.

The restaurant is based at 41 Victoria Street in Audas Estate, Somerset West, in the Helderberg area east of Cape Town, drawing diners from across the wider Somerset West and Strand area. It suits both a relaxed evening meal out and a takeaway order for those wanting authentic Indian flavours closer to home.

Neovision is a South African optometry franchise network offering eye tests, contact lens fittings and a retail range of prescription glasses, sunglasses and frames, with optometrists on site to diagnose and manage common vision problems. As part of a larger franchise, individual branches typically combine a consulting room with a retail showroom of frame brands and lens options.

This branch trades from Shop 13 in the Panorama Healthcare Centre, at the corner of Rothschild Boulevard and Hennie Winterbach Street in Panorama, a precinct built around medical and allied health practices. It serves patients from Panorama and the surrounding Parow and Bellville area who need an eye test or new glasses alongside other medical appointments in the same centre.

Nu-Sight Optometrists is an optometry practice offering eye tests, contact lens fittings and a retail range of spectacle frames and sunglasses, serving patients needing both routine vision checks and prescription eyewear. Independent optometry practices of this kind typically build long-term relationships with patients through repeat eye tests and lens updates over several years.

The practice is based in the Shoprite Centre on Voortrekker Road in Bellville, a busy retail strip in the northern suburbs, serving shoppers in the centre as well as the wider Bellville community. It gives local residents a nearby option for eye care without needing to travel to a larger specialist practice elsewhere in the city.

Panarottis is a South African Italian restaurant chain known for pizza served from a wood-style oven alongside pasta dishes, salads and a casual, family-friendly dining format that works for both sit-down meals and takeaway orders. Its menu and pricing are built around group and family dining rather than fine dining, with a self-service pizza buffet offered at some branches.

This branch trades from Shop 11 in the Stanhope Centre on Main Road in Claremont, a busy retail and dining precinct in Cape Town's southern suburbs. It serves diners from Claremont, Newlands and the surrounding university and residential area looking for a casual pizza and pasta meal into the evening, seven days a week.

Panorama Physio & Rehab Centre is a physiotherapy practice offering assessment and treatment for musculoskeletal injuries, post-surgical rehabilitation, sports injuries and chronic pain, using manual therapy and rehabilitation exercise programmes tailored to each patient. Practices of this kind typically work closely with referring doctors, surgeons and other allied health professionals as part of a patient's broader recovery plan.

Based on Rothschild Boulevard in Panorama, within the area's cluster of medical and allied health practices, the centre serves patients from Panorama and the surrounding Parow, Plattekloof and Bellville suburbs. It suits patients recovering from injury or surgery who need structured, ongoing rehabilitation close to other medical appointments in the same precinct.

Vodacom Shop Express is a mobile network retail outlet selling Vodacom contracts, prepaid airtime and data, SIM cards and a range of smartphones and accessories, alongside account queries and upgrades for existing customers. Express-format stores like this typically focus on quick, everyday transactions rather than the fuller range of services found at a flagship Vodacom store.

This branch trades from Shop 40 in Gugulethu Square, serving the surrounding Gugulethu community with a nearby option for airtime, data and device purchases alongside the centre's other retail and banking tenants. It suits shoppers needing a quick mobile top-up or device query while running other errands in the centre.

74 on 9th is a function and events venue hosting private celebrations such as weddings, birthdays and family gatherings, typically offering indoor and outdoor space suited to a range of group sizes. Venues in the Philippi Horticultural Area have become a popular, more affordable alternative to city-centre function venues for Cape Town's southern and Cape Flats communities, often set among smallholdings and market garden land.

The venue is based at 74 9th Avenue in Schaapkraal, within the Philippi Horticultural Area on the edge of Cape Town, giving guests a semi-rural setting away from busier parts of the city. It is best suited to hosts planning a private function who want space to accommodate a sizeable guest list.

Absa is one of South Africa's major retail banks, with branches typically handling everyday banking such as account openings, card services, cash deposits and withdrawals, loan and credit applications and general account queries for both individual and small business customers. As with most bank branches, much routine account management is increasingly handled through Absa's digital banking app and online platform alongside in-person service.

This branch is based at 1 Rothschild Boulevard in Panorama, in the medical and retail precinct around the Panorama Healthcare Centre. It serves Panorama residents and the surrounding Parow and Plattekloof area who need in-person banking services, with shorter Saturday morning hours covering weekend banking needs.

Absolute Pets is a national pet retail chain stocking pet food, bedding, toys, grooming products and accessories for dogs, cats and smaller pets, with many branches, including this one, also offering an in-store pet spa for washing, clipping and grooming. The chain's model combines everyday retail with these grooming services under one roof, making it a regular stop for pet owners rather than an occasional purchase.

This branch trades from Flamingo Square on Blaauwberg Road in Table View, a busy retail centre on Cape Town's west coast. It serves pet owners across Table View, Parklands and the surrounding Blaauwberg area, with trading hours that stretch into the evening on weekdays and cover weekends for grooming appointments and routine pet supply shopping.

Ackermans is one of South Africa's best-known value-fashion retailers, selling clothing, footwear, accessories and homeware aimed at the whole family, from baby wear through to adult sizes. Regular clearance sales and a layby facility are part of the chain's appeal to shoppers managing a household budget across several children or generations.

This branch operates from Shop 32 in Gugulethu Square on NY1, a busy retail centre serving the greater Gugulethu area. It gives local families a nearby source of school and work clothing and everyday essentials without needing to travel into town, and fits a quick, practical shopping trip rather than a leisurely outing.

Ackermans is a nationwide value-fashion chain selling clothing, footwear and homeware for babies, children and adults, with a reputation built on low prices, seasonal ranges and in-store specials rather than premium branding. It remains one of the most recognisable clothing retailers in township and community shopping centres across the country.

The Makhaza branch trades from Makhaza Shopping Centre on Cekeca Road in Khayelitsha, placing it within one of Cape Town's largest residential areas. It serves as a convenient, no-frills option for households buying school uniforms, workwear and everyday clothing close to home, rather than making a special trip into a larger mall.

Akmed Pharmacy is an independent pharmacy offering prescription dispensing and chronic medication management, alongside a range of over-the-counter health, wellness and beauty products for the local community. Pharmacies of this kind typically serve as a first point of contact for a minor ailment, with pharmacists able to advise on treatment or refer patients to a nearby doctor or clinic when needed.

Based in the Aashi Qually Centre at the corner of 4th Avenue and Lake Road in Grassy Park, the pharmacy serves residents across Grassy Park and the surrounding Cape Flats suburbs. Long daily trading hours, including into the evening and on Sundays, make it a convenient option for households needing medicine outside standard working hours.

Amazing Store is a general retailer stocking an everyday mix of kitchenware, household goods, toys, snacks and small gift items, the kind of variety store common in community shopping centres across the Cape Flats. Stores like this typically fill the gap between a supermarket and a dedicated specialty shop, offering a broad but affordable range under one roof.

This branch trades from Shop 6 in Colorado City Centre on Ceasars Drive, Colorado Park, Mitchells Plain, among the centre's other retail tenants. It serves local shoppers looking for household basics, a small toy or gift, or snacks while running other errands in the centre, open daily including an extended Friday evening trading slot.

APPA (Anderson Perry Partnership Architects) is an architecture practice working on industrial, commercial and complex residential projects, covering design, planning and the documentation needed to take a building from concept through to construction. Practices of this kind typically work closely with engineers, contractors and local authorities throughout a project, rather than offering a single standardised design service.

The practice operates from 16 Alma Road in Rosebank, a southern suburb close to the University of Cape Town, serving clients across the greater Cape Town area on projects ranging from factory and warehouse buildings to larger private homes. It works on an appointment basis, with weekday hours extending into the early evening to accommodate client meetings.

Athlone Pharmacy is a community pharmacy dispensing prescription medicine and chronic treatment alongside over-the-counter remedies, vitamins, baby products and everyday health and personal-care items. As a neighbourhood pharmacy rather than part of a larger retail chain, it typically serves a steady base of local patients who return for repeat prescriptions, medicine advice and day-to-day health needs rather than once-off visits.

The pharmacy is based on Old Klipfontein Road in Athlone, a well-established residential and retail suburb in Cape Town's Cape Flats area, within reach of several schools, clinics and other small businesses along the same road. It serves Athlone residents and surrounding suburbs with a nearby dispensary, trading through the week and on Saturday mornings for routine pharmacy needs without a long trip elsewhere.

A.Z. Berman Primary School is a public primary school offering the standard national curriculum from Grade R through to Grade 7, serving children from the surrounding Beacon Valley neighbourhood. As a no-fee school classified Quintile 4 by the Western Cape Education Department, it falls within the government's fee-exemption system for schools serving lower- to middle-income communities.

The school is based at the corner of A.Z. Berman Avenue and Kerrem Avenue in Beacon Valley, Mitchells Plain, drawing most of its learners from within walking distance of the school grounds. It functions as a neighbourhood primary school rather than a specialist institution, following the standard school-day timetable set by the provincial education department.

Bare Necessity is a boutique retailer selling sleepwear, home accessories and gift items, including body-care and home-fragrance products from the Charlotte Rhys range, aimed at shoppers looking for a smaller, curated gift and lifestyle store rather than a large department store. Boutiques of this kind typically rely on a more considered selection of stock than big-box retail offers.

The store trades from Dean Street Arcade at 15 Dean Street in Newlands, a small retail arcade in one of Cape Town's established southern suburbs. It suits shoppers looking for a gift, a treat for themselves, or home and sleepwear items in a quieter, boutique setting close to Newlands' other cafes and specialty shops.

Barksole is a shoe and leather repair specialist also offering key cutting, a dry-cleaning drop-off point and luggage repair, services aimed at extending the life of footwear, bags and other leather goods rather than replacing them. This kind of repair trade has become less common in large retail centres, with Barksole's branches filling that niche across several Cape Town shopping centres.

This branch trades from Shop 13 in Edgemead Village Centre on Letchworth Drive, Edgemead, serving the surrounding northern suburbs. It suits customers needing a repair to worn shoes or a damaged bag, a spare key cut, or a drop-off for dry cleaning while running other errands in the village centre.

Barno Plastics manufactures promotional and branded products in PVC, Polyprop and leather, along with branded stationery items, supplying businesses that need customised giveaways, corporate gifts or branded office items in bulk. Manufacturers in this space typically work directly with corporate clients and promotional product resellers rather than selling to the public over a shop counter.

The company operates as a Level 2 B-BBEE-rated business from Inyoni Street in Ndabeni, an industrial suburb close to Cape Town's CBD with a concentration of manufacturing and light-industrial operations. It serves corporate and promotional-industry clients across the greater Cape Town area, trading on weekdays in line with standard business hours.

Basilico has served Italian dishes from its Newlands premises since 1999, with a menu built around wood-fired pizzas, pasta dishes and salads in a relaxed, family-friendly dining room. Restaurants with this kind of tenure typically rely on a loyal, repeat local clientele built up over many years rather than passing trade alone.

The restaurant is based at 32 Kildare Road in Newlands, a leafy southern-suburbs neighbourhood known for its restaurants and nearby sports venues. It suits a casual dinner out, a family meal, or a relaxed lunch, trading through the week and into the evening on both Saturdays and Sundays.

Beacon Sweets and Chocolates is a long-established South African confectionery manufacturer, founded in 1931 and known for producing sweets and chocolate products distributed to retailers across the country. As one of the older manufacturing names still operating from its original Cape Town base, the company represents a different kind of local business to the retail shops around it, producing goods for wholesale and retail distribution rather than selling directly to the public on site.

The production facility is based on Inyoni Street in Ndabeni, an industrial suburb close to central Cape Town with a cluster of manufacturing operations. It forms part of the area's manufacturing history, supplying confectionery into supermarkets and retailers across South Africa from this long-standing Cape Town site.

Beacon View Primary School is a public primary school serving the Beacon Valley community in Mitchells Plain, offering the standard national curriculum from Grade R through to Grade 7 to over a thousand learners. As a no-fee public school, it falls within the government's fee-exemption system that supports schools serving lower-income communities, relying on state funding rather than school fees.

The school is based on Wanderers Crescent in Beacon Valley, drawing most of its learners from the surrounding streets and neighbouring residential blocks. It operates as a mainstream neighbourhood primary school, following the standard school calendar and timetable set by the Western Cape Education Department.

Beantree Coffee Shop is a casual cafe operating inside the Spar at Haasendal Gables, serving coffee, breakfasts and light meals such as pancakes to shoppers and locals passing through the centre. Cafes attached to supermarkets of this kind are built around quick, everyday visits rather than a destination dining experience, drawing much of their trade from people already in the store.

The cafe is based at Haasendal Gables on Bottelary Road in Kuils River, part of the Northern Suburbs wine-route area between Cape Town and Stellenbosch. It suits shoppers wanting a coffee and something to eat before or after a grocery run, trading daily from morning into the evening.

Beauty Zone is a body wellness and slimming studio offering treatments such as laser lipo and body sculpting alongside structured weight-loss programmes, aimed at clients working toward a specific body-shape or weight goal rather than general spa relaxation. Studios of this kind typically combine non-invasive body treatments with guided eating and exercise plans tracked over several weeks or months.

Based at 42 Plettenberg Street in Monte Vista, a northern suburb close to Panorama and Edgemead, the studio serves clients from across Cape Town's northern suburbs. It trades on select days through the week and on Saturday mornings, suiting clients who book treatments and consultations around a working schedule.

Belhar Islamic Primary School is an independent primary school combining the national curriculum with an Islamic ethos and religious education, serving around 387 learners across its primary grades with a staff of about 18 educators. Independent schools of this kind typically charge school fees in exchange for smaller class sizes, closer individual attention and a faith-based daily programme woven alongside standard academic subjects such as mathematics, languages and natural sciences.

The school is based at 31 Syringa Crescent in Belhar, a northern Cape Flats suburb with a significant Muslim community and several other faith-based institutions nearby. It serves families in Belhar and surrounding suburbs looking for a primary school that combines mainstream education with daily Islamic religious instruction, rather than a purely secular public school option.
